Public Function WNetGetUser() As String
Dim res&
Dim tbuf As String
Dim BufferSize&
Dim lenName As Integer
tbuf = String$(256, 0)
BufferSize = Len(tbuf)
res = intWNetGetUser(vbNullString, tbuf, BufferSize) 'отсекаем нули от имени
lenName = InStr(tbuf, Chr(0)) - 1
tbuf = Left(tbuf, lenName)
WNetGetUser = tbuf
End Function
